findings.title: The interdiff view can't show past the first file or page, and its comments land on the full diff
findings.detail: In INTERDIFF mode, interdiff_view.view reuses explorer.file_view(subject_with_interdiff_files, 0, page). Its Prev/Next file (file_pick), file picker, pager (nav view=file) and Comment (nav view=hunk_picker) buttons all call open_file, which reloads change.patch, the full change. So file 2 of an interdiff, page 2 of a long interdiff file and the interdiff hunks can't be reached. on_view_reply runs the quote locator only for kind=='file', so quote replies on the interdiff are stored file-level against the first interdiff file. 14.11.7 requires the same comment features as a file view. test_interdiff.py uses a single-file interdiff only. Fix: carry an interdiff source flag in the nav args, locate quotes for kind interdiff in INTERDIFF mode, and add a 2-file, 2-page interdiff test.

findings.title: AC 1 budget property test doesn't cover the real view builders or rich mode
findings.detail: test_kit_limits.py::test_every_builder_fits_its_budget fuzzes only a synthetic card_like view and the quoted chat answer. The production builders that take untrusted text get no fuzzing: cards.render per kind, explorer_view (9 sections), file_view, interdiff_view, comments.draft_view, queue.view, dashboard, edit picker/prompts, S12. Rich rendering isn't in the property test, and AC 53 ('maximal untrusted input never reaches ViewTooLarge') isn't covered for real builders. Register every production builder with maximal untrusted fixtures, in classic and rich modes.

findings.title: AC 5 goldens per kind and mode, and card-level purpose checks, are missing
findings.detail: tests/telegram/golden holds only dashboard.html and s1_title_256.html. AC 5 requires golden S1 cards in LIVE and DRY RUN for open_pr r1 and rN with interdiff, push_update, comment, issue_claim and skill_activate. It also requires the minted purposes and single_use flags of each published card to equal the 14.18.4.1 table, and comment/issue_claim cards to lack Explore, Files and Request changes. Only the purpose function (test_card_purposes.py) and the open_pr labels are tested. Add the goldens and a per-kind test over the ui_tokens rows of a published card.

findings.title: The AC 11 loudness cap has no test
findings.detail: CardPublisher._loud enforces telegram.loud_cards_per_hour (count of card: rows with priority 1 in the last hour), loud classes 0-1, and silent re-sends and autonomous proposals. No test touches it apart from the config range check. Add a test: 4 open_pr cards in an hour, 2 ring and 2 are silent; claims and user-directed cards ring past the cap; Show card is silent; a card an hour later rings.
